svg.text: Payment Reference Architecture (PRA) — Chatbot & Agent Layer
Executive Architecture Overview — AI agents grounded in the PRA knowledge graph
Browser-based chat — ask in plain English, get streamed answers with cited evidence and source links
Business Analysts & Payment Subject Matter Experts · no installation required
Every request arrives with a verified corporate identity and an entitlement scope — nothing reaches the agents anonymously
Identity carried to every agent & query
The Orchestrator Agent — receives every request, routes it to the right specialist, and runs one auditable pipeline
Picks the specialist for the job
Hybrid search over the knowledge graph
Confidence gate, then persist the turn
One reasoning pipeline for every agent — consistent, explainable, auditable
Specialist agents — each with one defined job; all share the same knowledge base, guardrails and audit trail
Domain Q&A on the PRA, answered with cited
Exploratory sparring on solution design options
Assesses how a proposed change affects the
Frames the business architecture view for
Builds user stories and acceptance criteria in
Challenges and refines drafts against the PRA
New specialists plug into the same
orchestrator, quality gate and shared services
Validator & Reviewer — the gate every agent output passes through
Checks every claim against the retrieved evidence and links each fact to its source document; PRA compliance checks to follow
One set of services behind every agent — no duplicated plumbing, one place to govern
Graph traversal + full-text + vector search, merged and
Claude Sonnet, grounded strictly in retrieved evidence
A standalone service that builds and refreshes the knowledge base. It is not
part of the live request path — the agents only ever read what it publishes.
Why it sits outside the chat flow
Runs on a schedule or on demand — no effect on chat response times
Can be re-run or extended without touching the live service
Every refresh will be validated before it goes live (planned)
Agents read the knowledge base; they never call this pipeline
Original documents are linked for reference only, never parsed live
Quality and consistency checks on every run
Graph updated; every fact keeps its source document
Secure record of every session, turn and retrieval
Enables follow-ups and hand-offs between agents
Full audit trail of what was asked, retrieved and answered
Entity cache for fast PRA name matching
The organisation's payment domain expertise — 846 nodes, structured & connected
Domains, functions, rules, patterns & anti-patterns — all linked
The single source of truth every agent reads from
Full-text index + vector search; every fact traceable to its source document

Two-way arrows = live request & response flow · Amber = offline ingestion (independent of chat) · LIVE NOW = running today · PARTLY LIVE = partly running · PLANNED = designed, not yet built · All services run within the enterprise network
